notes: §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR10, in format 3: a) GROUP INDICATE only in a detail group; b) 'A SUM clause may appear only in a type control footing report group'; c) a COLUMN entry without LINE subordinate to a LINE entry; d) 'Data-name-1 may be referenced only if the entry defines a sum counter.'; e) 'An entry that contains a VALUE clause must also have a COLUMN NUMBER clause.' ReportSectionBinder#ScreenReportEntryClausePresence asks a (group kind from #WrittenGroupKind, COBOL2519), b behind its DialectLevel < 2002 arm (COBOL6763), c by ancestry (#SubordinateToLineClause, COBOL2247) and e through Table 1 (#ScreenReportEntryClauseTable, COBOL2247); #ReportEntryReferenceRefused refuses d in the procedure division (COBOL5092) and #ScreenRolledAddend a SUM of a non-counter entry (COBOL6764). Probes at --std 85: GROUP INDICATE in a CH refused, in a DE printed once ('HELLO  HELLO' then '       HELLO'); SUM in DE, RF and PF refused COBOL6763; COLUMN with no LINE anywhere and COLUMN after a sibling LINE subtree refused COBOL2247; VALUE with no COLUMN refused; MOVE of a SOURCE or VALUE entry's name refused COBOL5092, of a sum counter allowed (-012 mid-report), SUM of a SOURCE entry refused COBOL6764, SUM of a CF sum counter rolls forward (12, 12). The witness is a VALUE entry with no COLUMN, refused COBOL2247.

next.reason: Kept: a) GROUP INDICATE only in a detail (§2023:13.18.28.3 SR1 'only within a detail report group description'); c) COLUMN without LINE subordinate to a LINE entry (§2023:13.15.3 SR9); e) VALUE needs COLUMN (§2023:13.15.3 SR13); d) the data-name stays optional (§2023:13.15.2 '[ entry-name-clause ]'). Changed: b) 2023 has no rule confining SUM to control footings and §2023:13.18.54.3 SR4 f lets the current group be a detail, report footing or page footing; d) 1985 allows a reference only if the entry defines a sum counter, while §2023:13.15.3 SR7 allows a reference 'as an operand in a SUM clause' to any entry, a SOURCE or VALUE entry included. Looser, compile-time.
